plugin.name: Apache Maven Dependency Plugin
plugin.description: Provides utility goals to work with dependencies like copying, unpacking, analyzing, resolving and many more.

mojo.description: Displays the list of dependencies for this project.

Displays the dependency tree for this project. Multiple formats are supported: text (by default), but also DOT <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DOT_language>, GraphML <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GraphML>, and TGF <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trivial_Graph_Format>.
